basics.name: Matthew Veres
basics.label: Research Engineer
basics.summary: Research Engineer at the University of Guelph specializing in applied machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. Experience spans automated industrial quality inspection, agri-food computer vision and robotic harvesting, robotic grasping affordance, and deep reinforcement learning.

work.name: University of Guelph
work.summary: Developing cutting-edge machine learning and robotics solutions for industrial and agricultural applications.
highlights: Designed and deployed deep learning inspection systems for industrial helical automotive gears detecting micro-scale defects within 7.5 seconds.
Developed multi-spectral (RGB + NIR) disease detection pipelines for fire blight in pear orchards using density estimation and few-shot learning.
Engineered computer vision pipelines for commercial greenhouse automation and tomato harvesting using Mask-RCNN.
Mentored graduate and undergraduate engineering teams and consulted on real-world industry AI projects.
Supervisors: Dr. Graham W. Taylor and Dr. Medhat Moussa
Focus: Deep learning generative models for robot grasping and manipulation
